findings.confirmed_problem: One unrelated unlinked Product replaced the current visible H1 and donated facts.
findings.minimal_source_pattern: H1 Current Coffee; lone unlinked Product Other Coffee with Variety Robusta.
findings.repair: Unlinked Product must agree with a present current heading/OG identity; same-name unlinked data may enrich a linked Product.
findings.regression: an unrelated unlinked Product cannot replace the visible current coffee or donate its facts

findings.confirmed_problem: Same-page matching ignored identity-significant query selectors.
findings.repair: Compare nontracking query parameters, preserving exact Shopify release identity for variant and collection aliases.
findings.regression: query product identifiers remain identity-sensitive while tracking parameters do not

findings.confirmed_problem: ListItem.item, URL-like @id and a Product following thirty recommendations were missed.
findings.minimal_source_pattern: ItemList -> ListItem.item -> Product @id, or thirty-five unrelated Products before the current one.
findings.repair: Bounded schema traversal includes item; exact-page candidates are prioritized under a 200-candidate cap.
findings.regression: ListItem-wrapped Products and their explicit URL-like @id remain readable

findings.confirmed_problem: Empty metafields shadowed metadata/attributes/options; inline wrappers discarded raw commerce/attribute evidence.
findings.repair: Read all recognized containers through shared conflict resolution; preserve raw inline Product properties for review evidence.
findings.regression: all structured containers contribute and empty metafields cannot shadow attributes

findings.confirmed_problem: Structured arrays silently lost every entry after five.
findings.minimal_source_pattern: Varieties array containing seven named values.
findings.repair: Retain complete bounded arrays that fit canonical limits; oversized arrays remain raw review evidence instead of a truncated canonical subset.
findings.regression: structured cultivar arrays preserve six or more entries without a five-value cutoff

findings.confirmed_problem: A soft 404 or browser challenge at a product-shaped URL became a coffee name.
findings.repair: Reject explicit error/challenge fallback headings.
findings.regression: soft 404 and challenge headings cannot become fallback coffee names

findings.confirmed_problem: Hidden generic nodes, quick views and additional recommendation names supplied unrelated facts; quoted attribute text could masquerade as visibility.
findings.minimal_source_pattern: hidden div Variety Robusta; class recommendations; You might also like; title containing aria-hidden text.
findings.repair: Quote-aware attributes and bounded component removal; retain only exact referenced hidden current-product panels, reject hidden/unrelated controllers.
findings.regression: hidden generic content and named unrelated components cannot supply coffee facts

findings.confirmed_problem: Independent regex trees did not share quote-aware structure; numeric explicit cultivar labels were rejected and legacy tokens could cross cards.
findings.repair: Use shared bounded structural scanner, allow explicitly labeled numeric cultivar codes, require legacy pair ownership by the same parent.
findings.regression: quoted angle brackets cannot break structural card ownership or numeric cultivar labels

findings.confirmed_problem: Country prevented richer compatible Origin data, while contradictory same-country regions silently preferred the first.
findings.minimal_source_pattern: Country Colombia + Origin Huila, Colombia; Origin Huila, Colombia versus Cauca, Colombia.
findings.repair: Enrich compatible segment supersets and withhold divergent full origins; preserve alternatives with conflict flags.
findings.regression: same-country conflicting regions and explicit producers are withheld with review alternatives

findings.confirmed_problem: Explicit producer, altitude, farm and rest contradictions silently selected one source.
findings.minimal_source_pattern: Producer Ana Torres versus Beatriz Morales; Elevation1800m versus1900m; Farm Aurora versus Luna; Rest7 versus21days.
findings.repair: Withhold contradictory canonical or supplemental summaries, retain raw alternatives; farm fallback conflicts do not erase an independently explicit grower.
findings.regression: conflicting farm and rest details remain reviewable without a misleading first-value summary

findings.confirmed_problem: Complementary Harvest and Lot values were treated as a contradictory release.
findings.repair: Retain a labeled composite release; contradictions within a harvest or lot stay final.
findings.regression: harvest and lot are complementary while contradictions within either label stay final

findings.confirmed_problem: The older espresso parser took precedence, collapsed ranges and borrowed from a nearby filter section.
findings.minimal_source_pattern: Espresso Dose18g Yield36g Time25s–30s; immediate h3 Filter supplied Yield45g Time30s.
findings.repair: Remove the older parser; use only the shared espresso evidence module repaired by requirements reviewer.
findings.regression: tests/coffee-runtime-audit.test.mjs

findings.confirmed_problem: Legacy nearby/story fallbacks could resurrect negated techniques or general altitude claims after safer narrative checks.
findings.minimal_source_pattern: This coffee was not an anaerobic natural; Coffee is generally grown at1800meters.
findings.repair: Sentence-bounded positive story evidence; remove unlabeled altitude guessing; all canonical conflicts remain final after blend/roast fallbacks.
findings.regression: legacy nearby and story paths cannot resurrect negated techniques or general growing altitudes

findings.confirmed_problem: Source scanning limits were invisible after product scope had already clipped the source.
findings.minimal_source_pattern: More than128 nested elements after an earlier readable specification.
findings.repair: Propagate scope truncation to source_facts_truncated; source fact limits are likewise explicit.
findings.regression: long review evidence exposes truncation while preserving canonical source scope

findings.confirmed_problem: Negation, historical and educational prose became positive process or grower facts.
findings.repair: Sentence-bounded current-lot context and negation/history guards.
findings.regression: tests/coffee-narrative-flavor-integrity.test.mjs

findings.confirmed_problem: Grower matching crossed sentence boundaries, truncated longer names and preferred the first contradictory producer.
findings.repair: Bounded multilingual names, explicit joint credits and unresolved contradictory current credits.
findings.regression: tests/coffee-narrative-flavor-integrity.test.mjs

findings.confirmed_problem: A farm location heading erased its explicitly named owner.
findings.repair: Preserve explicit owner before farm fallback.
findings.regression: tests/coffee-narrative-flavor-integrity.test.mjs

findings.confirmed_problem: Generic, impossible and reversed narrative altitudes became canonical.
findings.repair: Require current-coffee growth context, physical units and a plausible ascending range.
findings.regression: tests/coffee-narrative-flavor-integrity.test.mjs

findings.confirmed_problem: 16KB/45KB source windows and paragraph/prose count limits hid available current-product facts.
findings.repair: Scan shared bounded product markup, remove decorative content before text budgets.
findings.regression: tests/coffee-narrative-flavor-integrity.test.mjs

findings.confirmed_problem: Nested flavor containers, single notes, percentages and bullet/pipe notation were missed.
findings.repair: Structural flavor ownership with bounded literal note validation.
findings.regression: tests/coffee-narrative-flavor-integrity.test.mjs

findings.confirmed_problem: data-alt or alt-like text inside another attribute became product image evidence.
findings.repair: Unique, quote-aware real alt attributes only.
findings.regression: tests/coffee-narrative-flavor-integrity.test.mjs

findings.confirmed_problem: Image roast scale labels selected Medium; contradictory current image profiles disappeared without a conflict.
findings.repair: Reject legends/scales; propagate explicit roast and note conflicts to metadata.
findings.regression: tests/coffee-narrative-flavor-integrity.test.mjs

findings.confirmed_problem: Partial class tokens selected stale flavors and generic TAKE A SIP metaphors became notes.
findings.repair: Whole class tokens and literal sensory evidence; reject unrelated experience metaphors.
